title: Desktop Commander bounded provider operation definition
description: INTERNAL pre-authorized operation definition resolved by A-Conductor AFTER the opaque operation_ref has passed operator.v1/native-operation authority. This is not a model- or operator-facing payload and carries no raw command, argv, shell, executable, environment, prompt, SQL, or arbitrary script authority. Binding contract: docs/contracts/desktop-commander-bounded-transport.md.

operation_ref.description: Same opaque identifier semantics already used by operator.v1 job.execute and the native operation registry. It is resolved by A-Conductor authority only and is never shell text or a free-form command.

tool_family.description: Fixed closed set of bounded Desktop Commander tool families. Remote execution is expressed as a target device identity (device_id), never as a raw-shell family; REMOTE_SHELL and equivalents are forbidden.

project_id.description: Authoritative A-Conductor project identity reference. Every operation is bounded to this project scope.

mutation_intent.description: Explicit mutation intent. READ_ONLY operations must never mutate project or device state.

timeout_seconds.description: Bounded wall-clock budget for one operation. Hard bound: 1..3600 seconds.

max_output_bytes.description: Bounded output budget for one operation. Hard maximum 8,388,608 bytes (8 MiB); larger output must be paginated/tail-read by the future bounded transport adapter, never injected wholesale into model context.

device_id.description: Optional explicit registered remote-device identity. Only remote-device definitions may carry it; a missing or unknown device identity fails closed later. There is no discovery or polling behavior.
